contributions.statement: Never let a producing agent iterate against an LLM reviewer's numeric score: about 25 queries of semantics-preserving style edits (verbosity, formatting, emphasis) raised judge scores in more than 65% of attempts across five judge families, and style-control calibration did not remove the effect, so merge gates must rest on deterministic checks with LLM review advisory.
contributions.evidence: §6.2.1 Table 1, App. B.4 Table 7, §6.4 Fig. 5 (style control). Artifacts are chatbot answers and paper reviews, not code; audit notes no variance for Table 1, and random selection over the same edit catalog captures most of the gain.

reason: Turns known judge bias into a measured optimization-loop failure that existing calibration does not fix, which directly backs 'LLM proposes, deterministic gate decides'. The bandit itself is not the contribution.
